claim_text: --- ### Strands #### Strand 1: The plugin system treats Markdown as executable configuration **What I see** - `commands/hookify.md`, `help.md`, `configure.md`, `list.md` are all `.md` files with YAML frontmatter: ```yaml --- description: Create hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors from conversation analysis or explicit instructions argument-hint: Optional specific behavior to address allowed-tools: ["Read", "Write", "AskUserQuestion", "Task", "Grep", "TodoWrite", "Skill"] --- ``` - `help.md` says: > The hookify plugin makes it easy to create custom hooks that prevent unwanted behaviors.
